info.name: IPAM API
info.description: Full CRUD collection for IPAM + Assets modules. All requests require Authorization and X-Org-Id headers.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Site A",
  "slug": "site-a",
  "status": "active",
  "region_uuid": "<region-uuid>",
  "physicaladdress": "123 Main St, New York",
  "tenant": "default",
  "comments": "Primary datacenter"
}

item.name: IPAM Dashboard
item.description: Dashboard summary endpoint for the IPAM module. Returns KPIs, trends, breakdowns, IP activity, sites summary, and prefix health — all scoped by X-Org-Id.

item.name: Get IPAM Dashboard Summary
item.description: Returns: kpis (prefixes, subnets, public_ips, private_ips, devices, racks, vlans, vrfs, sites, ip_addresses, utilization_pct), trends (% change vs 30 days ago), vlans_by_status, vrfs_by_status, ip_activity_7d (last 7 days), sites_summary (per-site aggregates), prefix_health (top 10 prefixes by usage).

item.name: Create Purchase Order
item.description: Create a purchase order. Optional: attach a document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG, TXT - max 10MB). Use 'Create Purchase Order with Document' endpoint below if uploading a file.

item.name: Create Purchase Order with Document
item.description: Create a purchase order with document attachment (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG, TXT - max 10MB). File is uploaded to Firebase Storage and document_url is returned in response.

formdata.description: Optional: Attach any document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG, TXT)

item.name: Update Purchase Order
item.description: Update a purchase order. Use 'Update Purchase Order with Document' endpoint below if modifying or uploading a document. When status changes to RECEIVED or PARTIALLY_RECEIVED, assets are auto-created from the PO and a QR code is generated for each asset.

item.name: Update Purchase Order with Document
item.description: Update a purchase order and attach/replace a document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG, TXT - max 10MB). If a document already exists, it will be deleted and replaced. When status changes to RECEIVED or PARTIALLY_RECEIVED, assets are auto-created from the PO and a QR code is generated for each asset (stored at assets/qr/{uuid}/qr_code.png in Firebase Storage).

formdata.description: Optional: Replace existing document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG, TXT)

item.name: Assets
item.description: Asset management CRUD operations. Track physical IT assets including servers, network equipment, and hardware with warranty and depreciation tracking. QR code is auto-generated on creation and stored in Firebase Storage at assets/qr/{uuid}/qr_code.png. Documents are stored at assets/documents/{uuid}/{timestamp}_{filename}. On delete, both document and QR code are removed from storage. All operations include automatic activity logging.

item.name: Create Asset
item.description: Create an asset. QR code is auto-generated and stored in Firebase Storage (assets/qr/{uuid}/qr_code.png) — do not send qr_code_url. Optional: attach a document using 'Create Asset with Document' endpoint below.

item.name: Create Asset with Document
item.description: Create an asset with document attachment (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG, TXT - max 10MB). Document is stored at assets/documents/{uuid}/{timestamp}_{filename}. QR code is auto-generated and stored at assets/qr/{uuid}/qr_code.png — do not send qr_code_url.

formdata.description: Optional: Attach any document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG, TXT)

item.name: Update Asset
item.description: Update an asset. Use 'Update Asset with Document' endpoint below if modifying or uploading a document.

item.name: Update Asset with Document
item.description: Update an asset and attach/replace a document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG, TXT - max 10MB). If a document already exists, it will be deleted and replaced with the new one.

formdata.description: Optional: Replace existing document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG, TXT)

item.name: Delete Asset
item.description: Delete an asset. Also deletes the document (assets/documents/{uuid}/...) and QR code (assets/qr/{uuid}/qr_code.png) from Firebase Storage if they exist.

item.name: Assets Dashboard
item.description: Dashboard summary endpoint for the Assets module. Returns KPIs, trends, breakdowns, activity, spend analysis, top vendors, and sites summary — all scoped by X-Org-Id.

item.name: Get Assets Dashboard Summary
item.description: Returns: kpis (total_assets, total_pos, total_vendors, total_contracts, total_asset_value, total_po_value, total_contract_value, warranty_expiring_30d, eol_upcoming_90d), trends (% change vs 30 days ago), assets_by_status, assets_by_category, pos_by_status, contracts_by_status, asset_activity_7d (last 7 days created), spend_by_category, top_vendors (top 10 by PO value), sites_summary.

item.name: Activity Logs
item.description: Activity logging system with automatic Firestore enrichment. All logs automatically include org_name (from Firestore) and actor_display (human-readable user name from Firestore).

item.name: List Activity Logs (POST /query)
item.description: Query activity logs with advanced filtering. Returns paginated results with Firestore-enriched org_name and actor_display fields.

item.name: Create Activity Log (Manual)
item.description: Manually create an activity log entry. org_name and actor_display are automatically populated from Firestore based on orgid and actor_id.

item.name: Query Activity Logs (by module)
item.description: Query logs filtered by module (ipam, assets, system, etc.) with Firestore-enriched fields.

item.name: Query Activity Logs (by actor)
item.description: Search activity logs by actor (user) with full-text search on actor_display (Firestore-enriched human name).

item.name: Query Activity Logs (by target)
item.description: Search activity logs by target resource (device, vrf, site, etc.) with target_display search.
